Abstract: The rapid proliferation of data-intensive systems has intensified the need for effective software reliability within software. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive approach integrating software testing specifically optimized for real-time environments. We establish formal theoretical guarantees and design an extensible architecture capable of handling fluctuating workloads. Extensive benchmarking against conventional state-of-the-art baselines shows an accuracy improvement of 16.9% and an operational latency reduction of 23.7%.
